theme: A travel day into Maine, with an early start waiting tomorrow.
greeting: You landed in Portland this afternoon, Dan, and the day is mostly behind you. The one thing worth an alarm is the 7 AM call with Mike, Martin and Davit.

needsAttention.title: Early Valoris call opens the day
needsAttention.detail: Mike has set a 7 AM Teams call with you, Martin and Davit — the earliest thing on the week. Worth deciding tonight what you want to walk out of it with.

needsAttention.title: December break still undecided
needsAttention.detail: The all-kids December trip (Dec 13-Jan 2) was meant to be settled Sept 30 and booked by Oct 15 - holiday inventory for six over three weeks is the thinnest of the year, so the window is closing.

needsAttention.title: Maine Christmas SUV unbooked
needsAttention.detail: A refundable full-size SUV out of Portland for Christmas week is the hardest rental in that market and sells out; the task has been open since mid-September.

flagged.title: NACD New England event, Oct 28
flagged.detail: The Maine Visionaries group is being asked to share the Oct 28 event with their networks; Josh Broder has already pitched in - squarely in your board-governance circle.

flagged.title: VP Public Policy role at Equinix
flagged.detail: LinkedIn surfaced it alongside your government-affairs searches - an automated alert rather than outreach, but close to your profile.

flagged.title: Briefings site build failed
flagged.detail: GitHub flagged a failed Pages build on your briefings repo tonight, so the live page may not be redeploying.

flagged.title: A form before your next visit
flagged.detail: Your clinician would like a short check-in filled out ahead of the appointment.

inbox.noise: The rest is newsletters, promos and receipts - Bloomberg, the Press Herald, Alison Roman, a few store sales, and your Uber and Roma Cafe confirmations.

recipe.title: Fricassée of chanterelles
recipe.why: Autumn is peak foraging season, when wild chanterelles are at their earthy best.

Drive the Pathfinder Portland to St Pete

acts.line: A slow start in Florida before the midday flight north.
Tampa to Portland on MX 1004 - the afternoon was spent in transit.
Dinner at Roma Cafe behind you, with a 7 AM Valoris call opening tomorrow.
